metadata.title: That one accidental kill that made me question VALORANT physics again
metadata.description:
Wait, I actually got a kill? Didn’t deserve that one.
Watch me act like a pro when it was pure luck.
VALORANT logic strikes back!

Click if you’ve ever won by accident and still acted like a legend!

#valorant #gaming #funnyclips #fps #luckygamer
